Fiscal Year 2026-27 Departmental Budget Presentations
Pursuant to Section 25 2⁄3 of the County Charter, as amended by the Measure G Charter Amendment (as approved by voters in the November 5, 2024 General Election), Department Head presentations to the Board of Supervisors by the following departments of their Fiscal Year 2026-27 budget requests:
- Public Health
- Mental Health
- Public Works
- Regional Planning
- Agricultural Commissioner/Weights and Measures
- Parks and Recreation
- Beaches and Harbors 
- Animal Care and Control
- LA County Library
